item.title: [AWS Cloud Fundamental Notes] SQS
item.description:
Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) serves as a task buffer, allowing tasks that do not require immediate processing to be placed in the queue for storage.
When the system has spare resources, it processes these tasks, which helps decouple applications.

item.title: [AWS 101] What are SNS and SQS
item.description:
Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) and Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) may look similar.
But in reality, they are quite different.

To better clarify the differences between the two, let’s compare the notes on both services side by side.
